reviews.text: We had multiple companies out to quote us for a new furnace but Paras’ quote was the most reasonable, for a great quality furnace, with minimal extra charges (some companies like to tack on the extras!) Paras was friendly, reliable, clean and punctual. He answered any questions we had and managed our expectations throughout the process. We will gladly call on him again when the time comes. Thank you, Paras!

Paras is a great guy, always comes very quick if somthing is wrong, weve used him for years now & just replaced our whole furnace today, would 100% reccomend sync air for anyone thats looking for furnace or air conditioning / HVAC repairs!
Apreciate the service!

Very professional and excellent service. Paras installed my heat pump and did an outstanding job from start to finish. The work was clean, efficient, and done to a high standard. Pricing was also very reasonable. I would highly recommend him

Excellent, professional service. Very informative and knowledgeable. Paras handled the furnace and central air in our building and has done a wonderful job keeping us comfortable. Friendly and efficient, definitely recommend.

Responsive and professional service from start to finish. Clearly explained the issue, provided an effective solution, and resolved the problem quickly and efficiently. Highly recommend for their excellent customer service and quality work.
